DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_GrimGirl:
It has an uncontrollable urge to cut its prey apart.
Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment.
If caught by <characterName id=|GrimGirl|/>, pray that your head is taken first.

Chops up wild pals and spreads their <Status_Keyword>meat</> while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_GrimGirl:
While in party, 
the amount of items obtained from using the <itemName id=|MeatCutterKnife|/> increases by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. 
(Does not stack)

Gathers and splatters wild pal <Status_Keyword>meat</> around for their beloved while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
